exposure: postpartum pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) only
antepartum perineal massage and PFMT combined with postpartum PFMT
outcome: time to first sexual intercourse after childbirth
cohort: One thousand two hundred thirty-three women were enrolled and divided into two groups: those receiving postpartum PFMT only, and those receiving prepartum perineal massage and PFMT combined with postpartum PFMT.
finding: Women who underwent prepartum PFMT experienced significantly lower percentages of episiotomy, high-grade obstetric tear, or instrumental delivery, higher percentages of intact perineum, improved sexual function at 3 months, earlier first sexual intercourse, and a lower incidence of stress urinary incontinence compared to those who received postpartum PFMT only.
mod_finding: Women who underwent prepartum PFMT experienced significantly lower percentages of episiotomy, high-grade obstetric tear or instrumental delivery and higher percentages of intact perineum.
